truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 correctly identified 11 of the 20 true vulnerabilities: SC-V3-001, 002, 004, 005, 006, 007, 009, 010, 011, 013, and 020 (including the newly-added integer division-by-zero in calculate_route_score). It missed 9 vulnerabilities: SC-V3-003 (use-after-free in memory-pool cleanup), SC-V3-008 (path traversal in config loading), SC-V3-012 (thread-unsafe timestamp cache), SC-V3-014 (persistent auth state), SC-V3-015 (unhandled exception in variable parsing), SC-V3-016 (integer underflow in block split), SC-V3-017 (unbounded recursion in parser), SC-V3-018 (data race in result cache), and SC-V3-019 (TOCTOU in config loading). All 14 reported findings are supported by exact source evidence (no false positives). The systematic error was under-scoring severity (High instead of Critical, Medium instead of High, Low instead of Medium) and misclassifying CWEs (CWE-787 instead of CWE-120/122, CWE-798 instead of CWE-511, CWE-330 instead of CWE-338, CWE-78 instead of CWE-377). The summary's claim that all findings remain 'accurate in type, severity, CWE, and location' is itself an overclaim, as the severity/CWE discrepancies above demonstrate.
